academic_corrections_outside_source.issue: Some supplied prepared paragraphs describe Indian review as confined to substantive competence and contrast it too sharply with American due process.
academic_corrections_outside_source.treatment: Keep supplied reader unchanged. Teach the qualified modern position separately: constitutional rights, procedural fairness and reasonableness are not categorically excluded from Indian judicial review; the chapter's own Maneka Gandhi discussion supplies relevant context.

academic_corrections_outside_source.issue: The Ninth Schedule cutoff should not be taught as an automatic invalidation of every later listed law.
academic_corrections_outside_source.treatment: The effect on the basic structure must be examined. The I.R. Coelho holding uses amendments on or after 24 April 1973, with qualifications for previously upheld laws and completed transactions.
